entries.name: IfcOpenShell
entries.what_it_does: IFC toolkit in C++ and Python, and the home of Bonsai, a Blender-based BIM authoring environment
entries.caveat: Scripting knowledge helps a lot; the Blender interface is not a drafting package
entries.description: Open source IFC library and geometry engine

entries.name: web-ifc
entries.what_it_does: WebAssembly IFC parser for the browser: geometry and properties at full speed
entries.caveat: Parsing only; you bring the interface and the workflows
entries.description: Reading and writing IFC files with Javascript, at native speeds.

entries.name: ThatOpen Components
entries.what_it_does: Web components for viewing, measuring and coordinating IFC models in a browser
entries.caveat: The successor to IFC.js and still moving; pin your versions

entries.name: xBim Essentials
entries.what_it_does: .NET toolkit for reading, writing and querying IFC
entries.caveat: The .NET option; smaller community than IfcOpenShell
entries.description: A .NET library to work with data in the IFC format. This is the core component of the Xbim Toolkit

entries.name: xBim Windows UI
entries.what_it_does: Windows desktop IFC viewer, validation and model tools
entries.caveat: Desktop .NET heritage; check the release cadence before depending on it
entries.description: The home of XbimXplorer and WPF components for your desktop BIM applications.

entries.name: xBim WebUI
entries.what_it_does: Web-based IFC model viewer from the xBim project
entries.caveat: Viewer only; lighter maintenance than the desktop stack
entries.description: Web components for xBIM Toolkit

entries.name: BIMserver
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted IFC model server with revision control and notifications
entries.caveat: Java, heavyweight, and the operational effort is real
entries.description: The open source BIMserver platform

entries.name: BIMsurfer
entries.what_it_does: Browser-based IFC viewer used by BIMserver
entries.caveat: A viewer, not a coordination or clash tool
entries.description: The latest version of the BIM Surfer WebGL viewer for IFC

entries.name: Bldrs Share
entries.what_it_does: Browser IFC review and collaboration, with links you can share
entries.caveat: Young project; validate against your own models first
entries.description: Share is a browser-based BIM & CAD viewer and collaboration platform.  Supports IFC, STEP, STL, OBJ, GLTF

entries.name: Speckle
entries.what_it_does: Open data platform that moves geometry and data between AEC tools
entries.caveat: Server to run; check the licence for commercial hosting
entries.description: The Speckle Server, Frontend, 3D Viewer, & other JS utilities.

entries.name: LibreCAD
entries.what_it_does: 2D CAD for drawing production
entries.caveat: 2D only, and DWG support is weaker than DXF: convert first
entries.description: LibreCAD is a cross-platform 2D CAD program. It can read DXF/DWG, and write DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG files. It supports point/line/circle/ellipse/parabola/hyperbola/spline primitives. The GUI is highly customizable, and has dozens of translations.

entries.name: QCAD
entries.what_it_does: 2D CAD with a mature DXF/DWG engine
entries.caveat: Community edition is GPL; some features are paid editions
entries.description: QCAD - The Open Source 2D CAD. QCAD is a cross-platform CAD solution for Windows, macOS and Linux. It supports the DXF format and optionally the DWG format (through a proprietary plugin).

entries.name: ezdxf
entries.what_it_does: Python library to read, write and automate DXF drawings
entries.caveat: A library, not a CAD interface; excellent for drawing QA scripts
entries.description: Python interface to DXF

entries.name: FreeCAD
entries.what_it_does: Parametric 3D CAD with BIM, FEM and drawing workbenches
entries.caveat: Real learning curve; a modelling tool rather than a construction platform
entries.description: Official source code of FreeCAD, a free and opensource multiplatform 3D parametric modeler.

entries.name: pdf.js
entries.what_it_does: PDF rendering in the browser; the base layer of most web drawing viewers
entries.caveat: Rendering and forms, not measurement or markup workflows
entries.description: PDF Reader in JavaScript

entries.name: PyMuPDF
entries.what_it_does: Fast PDF parsing, text extraction and manipulation in Python
entries.caveat: AGPL for the free tier: check before embedding in a product
entries.description: PyMuPDF is a high performance Python library for data extraction, analysis, conversion & manipulation of PDF (and other) documents.

entries.name: pdfplumber
entries.what_it_does: Extracts text, tables and coordinates from PDFs
entries.caveat: Text-based PDFs only; scanned sets need OCR first
entries.description: Plumb a PDF for detailed information about each char, rectangle, line, et cetera — and easily extract text and tables.

entries.name: Camelot
entries.what_it_does: Pulls tables out of PDFs into dataframes
entries.caveat: Merged cells and borderless tables defeat it
entries.description: Camelot: PDF Table Extraction for Humans

entries.name: Stirling PDF
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted PDF toolbox: merge, split, stamp, OCR, redact, compress
entries.caveat: General purpose; it knows nothing about sheets and revisions
entries.description: #1 PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere

entries.name: Tesseract
entries.what_it_does: The OCR engine behind most document digitisation
entries.caveat: Accuracy collapses on stamped, folded, hand-annotated drawings
entries.description: Tesseract Open Source OCR Engine (main repository)

entries.name: PaddleOCR
entries.what_it_does: OCR with strong layout and table understanding
entries.caveat: Model downloads and GPU expectations; keep documents in-house
entries.description: Turn any PDF or image document into structured data for your AI. A powerful, lightweight OCR toolkit that bridges the gap between images/PDFs and LLMs. Supports 100+ languages.

entries.name: Paperless-ngx
entries.what_it_does: Scans, indexes and archives documents with tags and full-text search
entries.caveat: An archive, not an EDMS: no transmittals, revisions or approval workflow
entries.description: A community-supported supercharged document management system: scan, index and archive all your documents

entries.name: Mayan EDMS
entries.what_it_does: Document management with metadata, versioning and workflow
entries.caveat: Setup effort is high and the interface shows its age
entries.description: Free Open Source Document Management System (mirror, no pull request or issues)

entries.name: BookStack
entries.what_it_does: Wiki-style knowledge base for procedures and O&M documentation
entries.caveat: Uncontrolled documentation: not a substitute for a document control system
entries.description: NOW MANAGED ON CODEBERG

entries.name: OpenProject
entries.what_it_does: Project management with Gantt charts, work packages, budgets and costs
entries.caveat: Not a CPM engine: no float analysis or claim-grade schedule reporting
entries.description: OpenProject is the leading open source project management software for product, project and portfolio management. A powerful Jira alternative with agile planning, issue tracking, roadmaps, Gantt charts, time tracking, collaboration features, and more. Available on premises or in the cloud. ⭐ Star us on GitHub

entries.name: GanttProject
entries.what_it_does: Desktop Gantt charting and critical path scheduling
entries.caveat: Basic resource handling; not scaled to multi-job construction programmes
entries.description: Official GanttProject repository.

entries.name: TaskJuggler
entries.what_it_does: Text-based project planning with real resource levelling
entries.caveat: Batch and syntax-heavy; you edit a plan file rather than a chart
entries.description: TaskJuggler - Project Management beyond Gantt chart drawing

entries.name: OR-Tools
entries.what_it_does: Google's optimisation toolkit, including CP-SAT for scheduling and sequencing
entries.caveat: You supply the model; it is not a scheduling application
entries.description: Google's Operations Research tools:

entries.name: ODK Central
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted server for mobile field forms, submissions and exports
entries.caveat: Not construction-aware: you design the forms and the workflow
entries.description: ODK Central is a server that is easy to use, very fast, and stuffed with features that make data collection easier. Contribute and make the world a better place! ✨🗄✨

entries.name: ODK Collect
entries.what_it_does: Android client for filling in ODK forms offline and syncing later
entries.caveat: Android only; iOS needs a replacement in the field
entries.description: ODK Collect is an Android app for filling out forms. It's been used to collect billions of data points in challenging environments around the world. Contribute and make the world a better place! ✨📋✨

entries.name: KoboToolbox
entries.what_it_does: Form builder and data collection platform with a mature offline story
entries.caveat: The hosted service is the easy path; self-hosting is real work
entries.description: kpi is the server for KoboToolbox. It includes an API for users to access data and manage their forms, question library, sharing settings, create reports, and export data.

entries.name: OpenDroneMap
entries.what_it_does: Turns drone imagery into maps, point clouds and 3D models
entries.caveat: Needs good overlap and ground control; outputs still need QA against survey
entries.description: A command line toolkit to generate maps, point clouds, 3D models and DEMs from drone, balloon or kite images. 📷

entries.name: COLMAP
entries.what_it_does: Structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo photogrammetry
entries.caveat: Research-grade interface; command line heavy
entries.description: COLMAP - Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo

entries.name: Meshroom
entries.what_it_does: Photogrammetry with a node-based graphical interface
entries.caveat: GPU hungry, and photogrammetry is not measurement-grade surveying
entries.description: Node-based Visual Programming Toolbox

entries.name: CloudCompare
entries.what_it_does: Inspect, compare, measure and clean point clouds and meshes
entries.caveat: Desktop tool with no project database or audit trail
entries.description: CloudCompare main repository

entries.name: Open3D
entries.what_it_does: Point cloud, mesh and registration algorithms in Python and C++
entries.caveat: A library, not an application; you build the workflow
entries.description: Open3D: A Modern Library for 3D Data Processing

entries.name: PDAL
entries.what_it_does: Point cloud data abstraction with pipeline processing
entries.caveat: Format and pipeline plumbing rather than end user tooling
entries.description: PDAL is Point Data Abstraction Library. GDAL for point cloud data.

entries.name: Potree
entries.what_it_does: Web viewer for very large point clouds
entries.caveat: Display and navigation only
entries.description: WebGL point cloud viewer for large datasets

entries.name: laspy
entries.what_it_does: Read and write LAS and LAZ point cloud files in Python
entries.caveat: File format plumbing; pair it with something that analyses
entries.description: Laspy is a pythonic interface for reading/modifying/creating .LAS LIDAR files matching specification 1.0-1.4.

entries.name: QGIS
entries.what_it_does: Desktop GIS used for site mapping, earthwork volumetrics and utility records
entries.caveat: Not CAD: plan production and sheet setup are limited
entries.description: QGIS is a free, open source, cross platform (lin/win/mac) geographical information system (GIS)

entries.name: GDAL
entries.what_it_does: The geospatial translation and processing library under almost everything else
entries.caveat: Command line and API only; unglamorous and everywhere
entries.description: GDAL is an open source MIT licensed translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats.

entries.name: GeoServer
entries.what_it_does: Serves map layers over OGC web services to browsers and apps
entries.caveat: Java stack with real operational overhead
entries.description: Official GeoServer repository

entries.name: pyproj
entries.what_it_does: Coordinate reference system transformations in Python
entries.caveat: Choosing the wrong CRS is still your problem, silently
entries.description: Python interface to PROJ (cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library)

entries.name: WhiteboxTools
entries.what_it_does: Terrain, hydrology and raster analysis for earthwork and drainage
entries.caveat: Terrain analysis focus; not a survey adjustment tool
entries.description: An advanced geospatial data analysis platform

entries.name: COMPAS
entries.what_it_does: Computational framework for structural geometry, analysis and fabrication
entries.caveat: Python, research-flavoured, and its own learning curve
entries.description: Main library of the COMPAS framework and CAD integrations for Rhino/GH and Blender.

entries.name: sectionproperties
entries.what_it_does: Cross-section properties, stress and capacity calculations
entries.caveat: Sections only, not whole-structure behaviour
entries.description: Analysis of an arbitrary cross-section in python using the finite element method.

entries.name: PyNite
entries.what_it_does: 3D frame finite element analysis in Python
entries.caveat: Frame elements; it is not a design code checker
entries.description: A 3D structural engineering finite element library for Python.

entries.name: anaStruct
entries.what_it_does: 2D frame and truss analysis with plotting
entries.caveat: Two dimensions only; teaching to practice grade
entries.description: 2D structural analysis in Python

entries.name: OpenSees
entries.what_it_does: Nonlinear structural analysis, widely used in earthquake engineering
entries.caveat: Research-grade complexity and steeper than a frame tool
entries.description: OpenSees Source Code Repository

entries.name: OpenSeesPy
entries.what_it_does: Python interface to OpenSees for scripting analyses
entries.caveat: The packaging and docs repository for OpenSeesPy; same complexity as OpenSees
entries.description: OpenSeesPy versions, doc, and pip

entries.name: EnergyPlus
entries.what_it_does: Whole-building energy simulation, the reference engine in the field
entries.caveat: Input files are unforgiving; garbage in, garbage out at scale
entries.description: EnergyPlus™ is a whole building energy simulation program that engineers, architects, and researchers use to model both energy consumption and water use in buildings.

entries.name: OpenStudio
entries.what_it_does: SDK and tooling around EnergyPlus for modelling workflows
entries.caveat: Version drift between SDK, GUIs and measures is a known pain
entries.description: OpenStudio is a cross-platform collection of software tools to support whole building energy modeling using EnergyPlus and advanced daylight analysis using Radiance.

entries.name: Radiance
entries.what_it_does: Daylight and lighting simulation
entries.caveat: Decades-old interface; script it or use it through Honeybee
entries.description: A Validated Lighting Simulation Tool

entries.name: Ladybug
entries.what_it_does: Climate, sun, wind and comfort analysis from weather data
entries.caveat: Grasshopper-centric in practice
entries.description: 🐞 Core ladybug library for weather data analysis and visualization

entries.name: Honeybee
entries.what_it_does: Daylight and energy modelling built on Radiance and EnergyPlus
entries.caveat: Needs Grasshopper or Python skill; not a design tool by itself
entries.description: :honeybee: A python library to create, run and visualize radiance studies. Core library of Honeybee[+].

entries.name: CoolProp
entries.what_it_does: Thermophysical property database for HVAC and refrigeration calculation
entries.caveat: A library; the engineering judgement stays with you
entries.description: Thermophysical properties for the masses

entries.name: OpenFOAM
entries.what_it_does: CFD for wind, smoke, ventilation and airflow studies
entries.caveat: Specialist tooling: meshing, not modelling, is the hard part
entries.description: OpenFOAM Foundation development repository

entries.name: openLCA
entries.what_it_does: Life cycle assessment software, open source but distributed outside GitHub
entries.caveat: Result quality depends on the database you licence, not on the software

entries.name: Brightway
entries.what_it_does: Python framework for life cycle assessment (Brightway 2.5)
entries.caveat: Version churn is real: 2.5 and 2.x are not interchangeable
entries.description: A wrapper library for documentation and easy installation of Brightway 2.5

entries.name: eemeter
entries.what_it_does: Normalises meter data into energy savings figures
entries.caveat: Aimed at utility programme evaluation rather than site work
entries.description: An open-source python package for implementing and developing standard methods for calculating normalized metered energy consumption and avoided energy use.

entries.name: ERPNext
entries.what_it_does: Open ERP with projects, timesheets, purchasing and accounting
entries.caveat: Not construction-native: no AIA billing, WIP schedule or retainage without customisation
entries.description: Free and Open Source Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

entries.name: Odoo
entries.what_it_does: ERP with project, timesheet and analytic accounting
entries.caveat: Community edition has no construction apps; licensing differs between editions
entries.description: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.

entries.name: Tryton
entries.what_it_does: Modular ERP with accounting, projects and timesheets
entries.caveat: You build the construction layer yourself
entries.description: Mirror of tryton

entries.name: Dolibarr
entries.what_it_does: ERP and CRM for small organisations, with invoicing and projects
entries.caveat: Job costing is thin for construction
entries.description: Dolibarr ERP CRM is a modern software package to manage your company or foundation's activity (contacts, suppliers, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, accounting, ...). it's an open source Web application (written in PHP) designed for businesses of any sizes, foundations and freelancers.

entries.name: GnuCash
entries.what_it_does: Double-entry accounting for small businesses
entries.caveat: No job costing at construction scale; fine for a tiny outfit only
entries.description: GnuCash Double-Entry Accounting Program.

entries.name: Plane
entries.what_it_does: Issue and project tracking with cycles and modules
entries.caveat: Generic project tooling; no construction workflow built in
entries.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.

entries.name: Vikunja
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted task and project lists
entries.caveat: Lightweight by design; no scheduling or costing
entries.description: The task manager you actually own.

entries.name: Nextcloud
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted file sharing, document collaboration and office integration
entries.caveat: File sharing, not document control: no transmittals or revisions
entries.description: ☁️ Nextcloud server, a safe home for all your data

entries.name: Outline
entries.what_it_does: Team knowledge base for procedures and standards
entries.caveat: A wiki; discipline still decides whether it stays current
entries.description: The fastest knowledge base for growing teams. Beautiful, realtime collaborative, feature packed, and markdown compatible.

entries.name: Zulip
entries.what_it_does: Threaded team chat, which suits project discussions better than channels
entries.caveat: Operational effort to host; adoption is the real risk
entries.description: Zulip server and web application. Open-source team chat that helps teams stay productive and focused.

entries.name: Mattermost
entries.what_it_does: Self-hosted team chat with file sharing and integrations
entries.caveat: Ops burden, and the mobile app matters on site
entries.description: Mattermost is an open source platform for secure collaboration across the entire software development lifecycle..

entries.name: ROS 2
entries.what_it_does: Robot middleware: perception, navigation and control architecture
entries.caveat: Robotics engineering, not construction work; the field is hard
entries.description: The Robot Operating System, is a meta operating system for robots.

entries.name: Navigation2
entries.what_it_does: Navigation and path planning stack for mobile robots
entries.caveat: Assumes a known map and an engineered environment
entries.description: ROS 2 Navigation Framework and System

entries.name: LinuxCNC
entries.what_it_does: Machine control for CNC fabrication equipment
entries.caveat: Shop fabrication rather than site work
entries.description: LinuxCNC controls CNC machines. It can drive milling machines, lathes, 3d printers, laser cutters, plasma cutters, robot arms, hexapods, and more.

entries.name: grbl
entries.what_it_does: Motion control firmware for CNC machines
entries.caveat: Firmware for hobby and small machines
entries.description: An open source, embedded, high performance g-code-parser and CNC milling controller written in optimized C that will run on a straight Arduino

entries.name: Universal Gcode Sender
entries.what_it_does: Sends G-code to CNC controllers
entries.caveat: Shop tooling; not a production control system
entries.description: A cross-platform G-Code sender for GRBL, Smoothieware, TinyG and G2core.

entries.name: OctoPrint
entries.what_it_does: Web control for 3D printers
entries.caveat: Prototyping and small-scale fabrication
entries.description: OctoPrint is the snappy web interface for your 3D printer!

entries.name: Ultralytics YOLO
entries.what_it_does: Object detection and segmentation; the usual starting point for PPE and progress detection
entries.caveat: You must train on your own site imagery; published models do not transfer for free
entries.description: Ultralytics YOLO27, YOLO26, YOLO11, YOLOv8 — object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, image classification, pose estimation, object tracking

entries.name: Detectron2
entries.what_it_does: Detection and segmentation toolkit from Meta AI
entries.caveat: Research maintenance cadence; expect to pin versions
entries.description: Detectron2 is a platform for object detection, segmentation and other visual recognition tasks.

entries.name: Segment Anything
entries.what_it_does: Promptable image segmentation
entries.caveat: Check the weights licence for commercial use before building on it
entries.description: The repository provides code for running inference with the SegmentAnything Model (SAM), links for downloading the trained model checkpoints, and example notebooks that show how to use the model.

entries.name: RoadDamageDetector
entries.what_it_does: Road damage image dataset and detection baselines
entries.caveat: One country's roads: treat it as a benchmark, not a trained model for your site
